visual_synopsis: A family wheels a young man in a red cap and patterned vest along the corridor of an institutional building and into a bare hall of empty chairs, where a bearded man in a blue shirt and tie performs sweeping faith-healer gestures with his arms over his head; a visual-effects shot shows beams of light blasting out of the computer monitors on the front desk. Afterwards the family confers anxiously in the corridor and the young man is seen walking away on his own two feet, the wheelchair left behind.
